017package org.apache.juneau.http.response;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.Shorts.*;
020
021import org.apache.juneau.http.*;
022
023/**
024 * Represents an <c>HTTP 428 Precondition Required</c> error response.
025 *
026 * <p>
027 * The origin server requires the request to be conditional.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * <b>Beta — API subject to change:</b> This type is part of the next-generation REST client and HTTP stack
031 * ({@code org.apache.juneau.marshall.ng.*}).
032 * It is not API-frozen: binary- and source-incompatible changes may appear in the <b>next major</b> Juneau release
033 * (and possibly earlier).
034 *
035 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
036 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/NextGenRestClient">juneau-ng REST client</a>
037 * </ul>
038 *
039 * @since 9.2.1
040 */
041@SuppressWarnings({
042   "java:S110" // intentional — mirrors the HTTP status-code response hierarchy
043})
044public class PreconditionRequired extends BasicHttpException {
045
046   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
047
048   /** HTTP status code */
049   public static final int STATUS_CODE = 428;
050
051   /** Reason phrase */
052   public static final String REASON_PHRASE = "Precondition Required";
053
054   /**
055    * Constructor with no message.
056    */
057   public PreconditionRequired() {
058      super(STATUS_CODE, REASON_PHRASE);
059   }
060
061   /**
062    * Constructor with a {@link String#format(String, Object...) String.format}-style message.
063    *
064    * @param msg The detail message. May be <jk>null</jk>.
065    *    Treated as a {@link String#format(String, Object...) String.format}-style format string (<c>%s</c> placeholders) when {@code args} is non-empty.
066    * @param args Optional message arguments.
067    */
068   public PreconditionRequired(String msg, Object...args) {
069      super(STATUS_CODE, REASON_PHRASE, msg, args);
070   }
071
072   /**
073    * Constructor with a cause.
074    *
075    * @param cause The cause. May be <jk>null</jk>.
076    */
077   public PreconditionRequired(Throwable cause) {
078      super(STATUS_CODE, REASON_PHRASE, cause, cause != null ? cause.getMessage() : null);
079   }
080
081   /**
082    * Constructor with a cause and a {@link String#format(String, Object...) String.format}-style message.
083    *
084    * @param cause The cause. May be <jk>null</jk>.
085    * @param msg The detail message. May be <jk>null</jk>.
086    *    Treated as a {@link String#format(String, Object...) String.format}-style format string (<c>%s</c> placeholders) when {@code args} is non-empty.
087    * @param args Optional message arguments.
088    */
089   public PreconditionRequired(Throwable cause, String msg, Object...args) {
090      super(STATUS_CODE, REASON_PHRASE, cause, msg, args);
091   }
092
093   /**
094    * Copy constructor.
095    *
096    * @param copyFrom The instance to copy. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
097    */
098   public PreconditionRequired(PreconditionRequired copyFrom) {
099      super(copyFrom);
100   }
101
102   @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpException */
103   public PreconditionRequired unmodifiable() {
104      return this instanceof UnmodifiableBean ? this : new Unmodifiable(this);
105   }
106
107   /**
108    * Unmodifiable point-in-time snapshot of the enclosing {@link PreconditionRequired} exception.
109    *
110    * <p>
111    * Its only behavioral override is {@link #modify(Runnable)}, which throws — because all mutation is funneled through
112    * {@code modify(...)}, this single override freezes the entire mutation surface.
113    */
114   public static class Unmodifiable extends PreconditionRequired implements UnmodifiableBean {
115
116      private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
117
118      /**
119       * Constructor.
120       *
121       * @param copyFrom The exception to snapshot.  Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
122       */
123      @SuppressWarnings({
124         "java:S1699" // Paradigm intentionally calls the overridable freeze() from the ctor to deep-freeze sub-beans.
125      })
126      protected Unmodifiable(PreconditionRequired copyFrom) {
127         super(copyFrom);
128         freeze();
129      }
130
131      @Override /* Overridden from BasicHttpException */
132      protected BasicHttpException modify(Runnable mutation) {
133         throw uoex("Bean is unmodifiable.");
134      }
135   }
136}
